standing.detail: Race assumed RaceNightElf from the pinned preset (not readable from WCL); override via RankInput.race.
Talents, APL, raid buffs, consumes, and encounter come from the pinned preset/skeleton — not from the log.
Profession-locked gems and items are excluded; professions are not modelled from combatant info.

WCL temporaryEnchant (effect id) is omitted: no effectId→itemId imbue table in db.json. Any mhImbueId pinned by the skeleton is carried unchanged into every candidate — including weapon candidates of the other stone family and off-hand items — so a weapon-slot delta is measured under the baseline's imbue rather than the candidate's (ticket 351).

items.name: Stainless Cloak of the Pure Hearted

plausibilityWarnings.message: wrist has no baseline row: the worn Shackles of Quagmirran is not in the candidate pool for this slot, so it gets no row of its own to compare against. The rows shown for wrist were still measured against Shackles of Quagmirran — their deltas stand — but nothing here shows you what it is worth to keep it.
No positive candidate in head: nothing in a full pool matches Wolfshead Helm's effect. Expected for a unique effect, but worth confirming it is not a measurement fault.
No positive candidate in chest: every alternative displaces Breastplate of Malorne and pays Malorne Harness's lost bonus. Check that toll is real before trusting the slot.
No positive candidate in shoulder: every alternative displaces Mantle of Malorne and pays Malorne Harness's lost bonus. Check that toll is real before trusting the slot.
